specs.Other Special Features of the Product: 2 Way Audio, Triple Lens/Triple Screen View, Wifi Connectivity

features: [TRIPLE LENS WIDE AREA COVERAGE]: Equipped with three 5MP Ultra HD lenses for an expansive field of view. The app-controlled main PTZ camera monitors moving areas, while the two manually adjustable side cameras can be positioned up, down, left, and right during installation to cover additional angles and reduce blind spots.

[5MP × 3 ULTRA HD VIDEO QUALITY]: Three high-resolution 5MP cameras deliver detailed and sharp video, helping you monitor people, vehicles, entrances, driveways, shops, warehouses, and outdoor spaces with greater clarity.
[FULL COLOR NIGHT VISION]: Capture clear and colorful footage even after dark with advanced night vision technology, helping you identify important details in low-light conditions.

[AI MOTION DETECTION & SMART ALERTS]: Intelligent motion detection automatically detects movement and sends instant notifications to your smartphone, helping you stay informed of activity around your property.
[TWO-WAY AUDIO]: Built-in microphone and speaker let you hear and speak through the camera using the app — warn intruders, communicate with family, or answer visitors from anywhere in India.

[WEATHER-READY OUTDOOR DESIGN]: Designed for outdoor installation, making it suitable for monitoring homes, villas, offices, shops, factories, warehouses, parking areas, farms, and building entrances throughout the year.
